why_capped: Inverting the reported bill through an energy-only tariff implied load factors above 1.0 for 148 of 498 households. The reported bill carries duty, FPPCA and arrears that this config excludes, so it overstates energy.
external_cross_reference: eMARC metered Basic households draw 3.33 kWh/day.
limitations: Monthly kWh is inferred by inverting a FY2025-26 tariff from a reported bill.
It is not a metered reading, and the survey predates that tariff year.
Households without a reported bill take their own split median, flagged as an assumption.
Split medians are computed within a split so no split informs another.
